name: ASM Technologies Ltd
tagline: Engineering-R&D-services firm that has stepped up into Design-Led Manufacturing for semiconductor capital equipment, aerospace and vacuum/thin-film systems — a real revenue inflection and a credible policy catalyst, but a ~100x re-rating from lows and family-remuneration governance flags (unconfirmed)
business_overview: Two segments: HiTech (design, prototyping, qualification and manufacturing of semiconductor/industrial capital equipment — the growth engine, via ASM Technologies / HHV – Hind High Vacuum) and Engineering Services (Forms & Gears precision mechanicals, product engineering for aerospace/industrial clients). Minority stakes / acquisitions: Myelin Foundry (20%, edge AI), Asmaitha Wireless (electronics/control). New plants at Dabaspet and Sriperumbudur operational; Rs 250 Cr Hosur LED-equipment facility; among the first firms to receive Capital-Goods-category grants under the government's ECMS with a ~Rs 565 Cr capex plan.
fundamentals_narrative: The step-change is real: consolidated quarterly revenue moved from ~Rs 50–60 Cr to >Rs 100 Cr from Q4 FY25, and Q1 FY27 was +62% YoY — achieved with only a small addition to the asset base, so incremental ROCE is very high. The DLM / semiconductor-capital-equipment positioning plus ECMS support is a specific, credible catalyst. Against that: the stock has re-rated ~100x from its 2020 lows (and ~2–4x in the last year), trades at a rich multiple (~90x+ earnings), Q3 FY26 was a disappointment even to long-term bulls, and there are governance flags — the MD's sons draw large remuneration (one, an 'Executive Director' who is also a professional racing driver, paid ~Rs 2.97 Cr in FY26, more than the MD).
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Community notes a >50% correction from the early-2026 top before a partial recovery; some large holders reportedly exited.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent ~40 of ~246 posts (topic 48012), Aug 2025–Aug 2026. Anchor bulls shanid (original 2020 poster) and ankit_george (low cost basis) supply detailed AGM/earnings notes and explain the ESDM-vs-DLM distinction. 34th AGM (Aug-2026) praised for 'much better execution clarity' and 2–3 year milestones. Bear/risk posts: Q3 FY26 'disappointing', technical breakdown / big-investor exits (tbhavesh), family remuneration (Avin).
community_signal: tbhavesh (elevated trusted user) is active but technicals-driven and cautious/bearish through early 2026 — not a conviction buy. Thread anchors shanid and ankit_george are high-conviction long holders but are not on the trusted roster. No core-tier call. No formal high-conviction call logged.
bse_notes: Not independently checked. Governance watch-items: promoter-family (MD's sons) remuneration is high relative to roles and to the MD's own pay. No SEBI action identified; promoter holding is not collapsing.
bull_case: Genuine revenue step-change (Rs 50–60 Cr → >Rs 100 Cr/qtr from Q4 FY25; Q1 FY27 +62% YoY) with minimal asset addition → high incremental ROCE
Design-Led Manufacturing for semiconductor capital equipment + government ECMS Capital-Goods grants (~Rs 565 Cr capex) — a specific, timely policy catalyst
Capability stack assembled: HHV (vacuum/thin-film), Forms & Gears (precision mechanicals), Myelin (edge AI), Asmaitha (electronics) — promoter executing an integration vision
27% ROCE / 25% ROE with a real order pipeline
bear_case: Re-rated ~100x from 2020 lows and ~2–4x in a year; ~90x+ earnings leaves no margin of safety
Q3 FY26 disappointed even long-term bulls; execution is not linear and a large capex phase is underway (asset-turn on new plants unproven)
Governance: MD's sons' remuneration high relative to role / to MD pay
At ~Rs 6,739 Cr, a literal 10x needs PAT from ~Rs 72 Cr to ~Rs 700 Cr — possible only on flawless multi-year semiconductor-DLM execution
verdict_headline: Real inflection + credible semiconductor/ECMS catalyst put it on the 10x map, but the ~100x prior re-rating, rich multiple and family-comp flags hold conviction at Medium (unconfirmed)
verdict_reasoning: Per the recent-inflection rule: small/mid-cap with a strong recent-quarter trend (Q1 FY27 +62% YoY, structural step-change from Q4 FY25) and a specific credible catalyst (DLM for semiconductor capital equipment + government ECMS grants) → 10x-in-2-3-years, tagged unconfirmed
Conviction capped at Medium: valuation has already run extremely hard, Q3 FY26 wobbled, new-plant asset turns are unproven, and there are promoter-family remuneration concerns
Revisit after the next 1–2 quarters to see whether the DLM order book and new-plant utilisation validate the re-rating

four_box.note: Semiconductor-DLM + ECMS grant catalyst (govt-backed) is a real tailwind; Q1 FY27 +62% YoY step-change supports tam via the recent-inflection rule; capability-stack integration (HHV/Forms&Gears/Myelin/Asmaitha) is unproven, not yet a moat; ~90x+ earnings after a ~100x re-rate leaves valuation no.
